description: AgMIP-Wheat collaborators released part of the International Heat Stress Genotype Experiment for comparing crop models under heat. It covers two spring-wheat cultivars across two winter cropping cycles at irrigated sites in Mexico, Egypt, India, Sudan and Bangladesh. The experiment includes sowing dates, local daily weather, soil starting conditions, flowering and maturity dates, biomass, grain yield and cultivar data. Daily and end-of-season outputs from 30 wheat models accompany the field observations. The named Harvard Dataverse page opened publicly, shows version 1.2, one downloadable RAR archive and CC0 1.0; no price was shown. A food-supply modeller can check heat-response and yield predictions against the observations or compare model outputs. The sites are a selected hot, irrigated sample, not a global field census. Field measurements must remain distinct from simulated values during calibration, and archive-level variable coverage was not inspected. This release is related to the earlier AgMIP wheat pilot benchmark in G4-0566, but the experiments and deposit DOIs differ. No catalogue identity match appeared in the full local duplicate scan.
name: Data from the International Heat Stress Genotype Experiment for modeling wheat response to heat: field experiments and AgMIP-Wheat multi-model simulations
